headline_finding: Across all 18 trials, the dominant failure was a city-set selection error: agents usually recovered the correct Digital Realty counts for Melbourne and Sydney but then overincluded Port Hedland after reading NEXTDC's 0.5MW Port Hedland line as a qualifying 2023 addition (2020cbde-1a08-4f42-8401-c9424d63e7ea, 3d378e47-d83d-449c-91fa-88d7de1a82a9, 412bccc1-6916-4301-9287-adbd04a99362, 447621cd-60c5-465b-a92e-f6f6f3e00a78, 44d1739c-b237-474d-bb13-6059fd518b71, 47d38702-9e84-4c53-97c4-0947ffb956ca, 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3, 617950dc-df20-4cf5-abc9-6fc38db96455, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, 625ce54e-a9fb-4f6d-aea8-4fdb8fc844a4, 69ec2d04-46cb-4472-abf3-5397e59f2ae5, c74965ae-a68f-4744-8bbb-ac6ccdefeb96, d5568ee0-aac4-45f8-80b5-2b7c49eae0ea, e75136df-dc6e-485f-84a0-cb234c9f5aa6, e95be11f-2b42-4564-a05b-735e71d532be, ebf021ab-ceea-400b-a83b-35ab576addc3, ed8d8f3b-a96d-45c9-926a-546fcc911445). One striking exception is e95be11f-2b42-4564-a05b-735e71d532be, where the same wrong three-city answer received a 0.25 ensemble reward, and another is ed1874d7-08f2-43a6-97b3-841c9ca45be6, where the verifier failed with `RewardFileNotFoundError` after an external 403. The task is coherent, but the benchmark is caveated by direct answer leakage in `/tests/ground_truth.json` noted in 412bccc1-6916-4301-9287-adbd04a99362, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, and 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3.
common_bottlenecks: All harness/model cells: they consistently recovered Melbourne and Sydney but misread NEXTDC's Port Hedland line as part of the qualifying 2023 set, producing three-city answers instead of the gold two-city answer (2020cbde-1a08-4f42-8401-c9424d63e7ea, 3d378e47-d83d-449c-91fa-88d7de1a82a9, 412bccc1-6916-4301-9287-adbd04a99362, 447621cd-60c5-465b-a92e-f6f6f3e00a78, 44d1739c-b237-474d-bb13-6059fd518b71, 47d38702-9e84-4c53-97c4-0947ffb956ca, 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3, 617950dc-df20-4cf5-abc9-6fc38db96455, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, 625ce54e-a9fb-4f6d-aea8-4fdb8fc844a4, 69ec2d04-46cb-4472-abf3-5397e59f2ae5, c74965ae-a68f-4744-8bbb-ac6ccdefeb96, d5568ee0-aac4-45f8-80b5-2b7c49eae0ea, e75136df-dc6e-485f-84a0-cb234c9f5aa6, e95be11f-2b42-4564-a05b-735e71d532be, ebf021ab-ceea-400b-a83b-35ab576addc3, ed8d8f3b-a96d-45c9-926a-546fcc911445).

Runs that explicitly checked the Digital Realty docs still failed because they turned `Port Hedland` into a zero-count row instead of removing it from the answer set; that is a city-filter mistake, not a lookup mistake (44d1739c-b237-474d-bb13-6059fd518b71, 625ce54e-a9fb-4f6d-aea8-4fdb8fc844a4, 69ec2d04-46cb-4472-abf3-5397e59f2ae5, d5568ee0-aac4-45f8-80b5-2b7c49eae0ea, ebf021ab-ceea-400b-a83b-35ab576addc3).
interesting_behaviors: A few runs first landed on the correct two-city answer and then drifted back to a three-city answer, which is a different failure mode from the one-shot overinclusion seen elsewhere (447621cd-60c5-465b-a92e-f6f6f3e00a78, 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3, d5568ee0-aac4-45f8-80b5-2b7c49eae0ea).

Several runs explicitly noted that Port Hedland was absent from Digital Realty but still wrote `0` for it, which cleanly separates retrieval from city-selection reasoning (44d1739c-b237-474d-bb13-6059fd518b71, 625ce54e-a9fb-4f6d-aea8-4fdb8fc844a4, ebf021ab-ceea-400b-a83b-35ab576addc3).

The verifier was noisy on identical wrong answers: 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3, and e95be11f-2b42-4564-a05b-735e71d532be each got a 0.25 reward, while ed1874d7-08f2-43a6-97b3-841c9ca45be6 crashed before scoring.
variance_across_cells: Across `claude-code`, `terminus-2`, `gemini-cli`, `qwen-coder`, and `codex` cells, the surface failure is the same: Melbourne and Sydney are usually correct, Port Hedland is added, and the final answer becomes three cities instead of two (2020cbde-1a08-4f42-8401-c9424d63e7ea, 447621cd-60c5-465b-a92e-f6f6f3e00a78, 617950dc-df20-4cf5-abc9-6fc38db96455, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, 69ec2d04-46cb-4472-abf3-5397e59f2ae5, ed8d8f3b-a96d-45c9-926a-546fcc911445). What differs is only when the wrong branch is chosen: some trials commit immediately after reading NEXTDC, while others derive the correct two-city answer first and then drift back to Port Hedland, so the root cause is city-selection rather than Digital Realty lookup (447621cd-60c5-465b-a92e-f6f6f3e00a78, 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3, d5568ee0-aac4-45f8-80b5-2b7c49eae0ea, 625ce54e-a9fb-4f6d-aea8-4fdb8fc844a4).

issues: The verifier can leak the exact answer path: 412bccc1-6916-4301-9287-adbd04a99362, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, and 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3 explicitly note that `tests/llm_judge.py` reads `/tests/ground_truth.json` and uses the stored answer in grading.

The prompt is semantically subtle because NEXTDC explicitly mentions Port Hedland with 0.5MW of built capacity, yet the intended answer excludes it; this is coherent but easy to misread (44d1739c-b237-474d-bb13-6059fd518b71, e95be11f-2b42-4564-a05b-735e71d532be, ed8d8f3b-a96d-45c9-926a-546fcc911445).
One trial crashed in the verifier before reward was written, so the scoring path is brittle even when the answer content is known (ed1874d7-08f2-43a6-97b3-841c9ca45be6).
task_quality.structural_hackability_notes: The judge loads `/tests/ground_truth.json` directly and compares `/workspace/answer.txt` against the stored expected answer; 412bccc1-6916-4301-9287-adbd04a99362, 621096f0-c2c7-408d-a209-b78a0b8211a2, and 4a5be415-29c5-451f-82f9-9a7536a34fa3 explicitly call this out.

super_capable_counterfactual: A strict city-filtering step that excluded Port Hedland and then wrote exactly `Melbourne - 2, Sydney - 4` would have flipped the content of the 17 near-miss trials and the partial trial ed8d8f3b-a96d-45c9-926a-546fcc911445; the only remaining blocker would have been the verifier-side crash in ed1874d7-08f2-43a6-97b3-841c9ca45be6.
notes_for_cross_task_aggregation: This task is dominated by a single semantic boundary error: almost every run had the right counts but the wrong city set because Port Hedland was overincluded. Cross-task rollups should separate city-selection errors from lookup errors, and should note that one trial had a verifier-side crash unrelated to the answer content (ed1874d7-08f2-43a6-97b3-841c9ca45be6).
